class.name: IfcElectricMotor
class.brief_description: An electric motor is an engine that is a machine for converting electrical energy into mechanical energy. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcElectricMotor defines the occurrence of any electric motor; common information about electric motor types is handled by IfcElectricMotorType . The IfcElectricMotorType (if present) may establish the common type name, usage (predefined type),
